in_sanskrit.name: Amankumar
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God's Grace and Power
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Amankumar एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Amara meaning 'Immortal' and KumaR meaning 'Lord or Ruler'. This name signifies the immortal and powerful God who bestows his grace upon us.

in_hindi.name: Amankumar
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God's Grace and Power
in_hindi.long_meaning: Amankumar एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Amara meaning 'Immortal' and KumaR meaning 'Lord or Ruler'. This name signifies the immortal and powerful God who bestows his grace upon us.

in_tamil.name: Amankumar
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் God's Grace and Power
in_tamil.long_meaning: Amankumar ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। Amara meaning 'Immortal' and KumaR meaning 'Lord or Ruler'. This name signifies the immortal and powerful God who bestows his grace upon us.

in_telugu.name: Amankumar
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే God's Grace and Power
in_telugu.long_meaning: Amankumar ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Amara meaning 'Immortal' and KumaR meaning 'Lord or Ruler'. This name signifies the immortal and powerful God who bestows his grace upon us.

in_marathi.name: Amankumar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God's Grace and Power
in_marathi.long_meaning: Amankumar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Amara meaning 'Immortal' and KumaR meaning 'Lord or Ruler'. This name signifies the immortal and powerful God who bestows his grace upon us.

in_bengali.name: Amankumar
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God's Grace and Power
in_bengali.long_meaning: Amankumar একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Amara meaning 'Immortal' and KumaR meaning 'Lord or Ruler'. This name signifies the immortal and powerful God who bestows his grace upon us.
